details.test: Original declared SQLite source-byte experiment repeated on repaired exact source, independent adverse mutation and integrity probes, Windows focused regression plus Linux isolated 41 tests /29 subtests /4 platform skips and13 adverse tests /0 skips. No live model efficiency conclusion.
details.expected: Two manifest pages for 120 x 64KiB objects read zero body bytes and one bounded metadata payload. Cold 2-byte range verifies complete 64KiB object plus touched blocks; warm same range reauthenticates only touched 8KiB blocks (two blocks for a boundary span). Corruption, missing/oversized/foreign source and changed identity are rejected. Counts are SQLite blob bytes, not physical disk I/O; metadata trust is per execution and SQLite cache target is not a total RSS promise.
